BR-60

BRAKE SYSTEM — Anti-lock Brake System (A.B.S.)

5
Anti-lock brake system works inefficiently.

Disconnect actuator check connector.
(See page BR-52)

Does warning light show the diagnostic normal
code? (Ignition switch on)

NO
See diagnostic code.
(See page BR-53)

YES

Is there battery voltage between computer
terminal STP and body ground when
depressing brake pedal?

NO
Open circuit in stop light switch and/or
wire harness.

YES

Inspect actuator.
(See page BR-61)
